name: BizReview – Business and Google Place Review Plugin
author: ThemeAtelier

sections.description:
Bizreview Business and Google Place Review WordPress Plugin for display Google Reviews & Ratings to increase user confidence, SEO and traffic of your Business. This plugin help you to increase sales with social proof. This plguin has 14 different option to showcase your Google place reviews. There has option to generate shortcodes so you will able to use this shortcode in your pages, posts or anywhere you want in your WordPress website. The shortcode also can be use in any popular page builders like Gutenburg, Elementor or WpBekary. If you use elementor you have elementor widgets to use.

👁️Plugin Demo | 🚀Pro Version | 📝Docs |👩🏼‍💻Support | 🌟Rate this plugin

Key Features:

  • Displays 5 Google business reviews per location ( 5 review restricted by Google API )
  • Fetching Review Based on Google API
  • Google Place Information badges
  • 14 + review style
  • Review Slider
  • Review Grid
  • Review Masonary Grid
  • Review Elementor Widget support
  • Review Widget
  • Review Shortcode
  • Settings Options
  • Multipale Place review option
  • Use multiple times in a page.
  • Global Place review option
  • Rating Filtering option
  • Trim Long Reviews
  • Multisite Supported.
  • RTL Supported.
  • Multilingual Ready.
  • SEO friendly & optimized for speed.
  • Support all modern browsers: IE, Firefox, Chrome, Safari, Opera, Edge, etc.
  • Well Online Documentation
  • SASS/SCSS Files included
  • Error Free
  • Fast and Active Support.
  • And much more.

OTHER AMAZING PRODUCTS FROM ThemeAtelier

➡️ Better WhatsApp Chat Support – A WordPress plugin that allows website owners to easily add a WhatsApp chat bubble to their website and comes with Gutenberg, Elementor and Shortcode options.

➡️ Darkify Dark Mode – Lightweight, customizable WordPress dark mode plugin for a sleek, accessible, and eye-friendly experience on both frontend and admin dashboard.

➡️ Eventful for Elementor – Events Showcase For The Events Calendar and Elementor – Elevate your event management with this dynamic addon, enhancing ‘The Events Calendar’ with versatile layouts, advanced filtering, and user-friendly features for superior event showcasing.

➡️ Greet – Video Bubble Warm Welcome Plugin – A powerful and user-friendly video bubble plugin for WordPress that provides website owners with the opportunity to create a dynamic and engaging welcome experience for their visitors.

➡️ Domain For Sale – Transform your unused domain names into cash with this easy-to-use plugin that provides a professional template, customizable options, and a contact form for effortless selling.
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘BizReview’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Where do I get Support?

You can contact us trough this channels
WordPress Plugin Directory || Facebook Page || Codecanyon

Is it translation ready?

Yes. The plugin is totally translation ready. If it’s not support in your language you need to edit it with any translation plugin.
